#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate data/timing.txt with 3 ascending epoch timing lines. No numpy."""
import os

def main():
    out_dir = "data"
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "timing.txt")

    # Three ascending millisecond timings (strictly increasing).
    timings_ms = [10, 20, 40]

    lines = []
    for i, ms in enumerate(timings_ms):
        lines.append("epoch{0}={1}".format(i, ms))

    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

    print("Wrote {0}".format(out_path))
    print("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
